dct_title_s: Vietnam Floods: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Aug 2023
dct_description_sm: # Vietnam Floods: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Aug 2023 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage and flood proxy maps for Vietnam Floods (Aug 2023) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Vietnam, Heavy Rains, 9 Aug 2023, v0.4** - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Vietnam, Floods, 9 Aug 2023, v0.3** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Advanced Rapid Imaging and Analysis (ARIA), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2023).
